    52	class Campaign(object):
    53	    """The whole offline campaign: compilation and replay certificate."""
    54	
    55	    def __init__(self, document):
    56	        if not isinstance(document, dict):
    57	            raise InvalidCampaign("campaign must be an object")
    58	        self.table = build_types(document.get("types"))
    59	        self.modules = build_modules(document.get("modules"), self.table)
    60	        self.graph = DependencyGraph(self.modules, document.get("calls"),
    61	                                     document.get("pipes"))
    62	        entries = document.get("entries")
    63	        if not isinstance(entries, list):
    64	            raise InvalidCampaign("entries must be a list")
    65	        if len(entries) > 32:
    66	            raise InvalidCampaign("too many entries")
    67	        for entry in entries:
    68	            if not isinstance(entry, str) or entry not in self.modules:
    69	                raise InvalidCampaign("unknown entry " + repr(entry))
    70	        if len(set(entries)) != len(entries):
    71	            raise InvalidCampaign("duplicate entry")
    72	        self.entries = list(entries)
    73	        machine = document.get("machine")
    74	        self.machine = Machine(machine) if machine is not None else None
    75	        self.runs = document.get("runs")
    76	        if not isinstance(self.runs, list):
    77	            raise InvalidCampaign("runs must be a list")
    78	        self.plans = [self._plan(entry) for entry in self.entries]
    79	        self.plans_by_entry = {plan.entry: plan for plan in self.plans}
    80	        self._guard_cache = {}
    81	        self._analysis = {}
    82	        self._preparation = {}

    84	    # -- compilation -------------------------------------------------------

    86	    def _plan(self, entry):
    87	        """Compile one entry: module order, declarations, slots, filters."""
    88	        module = self.modules[entry]
    89	        order = self.graph.compile_order(entry)
    90	        declarations = self.graph.type_declarations(order, self.modules)
    91	        applications = self.graph.composed_applications(entry)
    92	        flag_needed = bool(self.graph.pipes_by_target.get(entry))
    93	        harness = build_harness(module, flag_needed)
    94	        return Plan(entry, module, order, declarations, harness, applications)
